description: Return the stores getcheapgames compares, official stores and key marketplaces, with each one's coverage in the market's currency. Use it to say which stores are covered or which most often has the lowest price; for one game's price at each store use get_game_offers. `country` sets the currency the counts are taken in: timesCheapest is how many of the ofGamesCompared games a store is cheapest for right now, and a store with nothing priced in that currency has null counts, not zero. Also returns how offers are ranked and the site's totals of games and offers tracked.

country.description: Two-letter market code, any case, e.g. de, gb, us, br or pl (40 markets). It decides the currency prices come back in, which keys count as region-locked, and the market every link opens in. Omitted or unsupported codes fall back to ie (Ireland, euro).

name: list_stores
title: List compared stores
